title: Novel photochromic system using methylene blue reduction with L-ascorbic acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39708-39714
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07408D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Takahiro Suzuki, Fuka Nakamura, Kanon Ie, Masaaki Fujii, Masayuki Inoue
A novel photochromic system was discovered, in which leucomethylene blue, reduced by L-ascorbic acid, was irradiated with 405 nm visible light, resulting in the solution undergoing a colorless-to-blue transition.
